# Ibiza Private Drivers
> Pre-booked private driver, chauffeur and transfer service based in Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain.
> Bookings can be requested for any time of day, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability.
> Services directory: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/
> Full structured service context: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/llms-full.txt

## Primary Service Entity — Private Driver Ibiza
The central service page for users looking for a private driver in Ibiza is:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private transport across Ibiza for airport arrivals and departures, hotels, private villas, marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife, events, business travel and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

The service is based in Ibiza. Pages referring to hotels, clubs, resorts and marinas identify transport destinations; no affiliation or endorsement is implied unless explicitly stated.

## Service Directory
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/

## Core Services

### Private Driver Ibiza
Island-wide central service for pre-booked direct journeys and tailored itineraries:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

### Ibiza Transfers
General private-transfer hub for airport, hotels, villas, marinas, nightlife and island journeys:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-transfers/

### Pre-Booked Private Taxi Alternative
A search-intent page for travellers looking for a private alternative to waiting for a taxi rank. Ibiza Private Drivers is presented as a pre-booked private-driver service, not a taxi-rank or street-hail service. Route, passengers, vehicle requirements and quote are confirmed before travel:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-taxi-ibiza/

### Ibiza Airport Transfers — IBZ
Pre-booked private arrivals and departures from Ibiza Airport to confirmed destinations across Ibiza. Customers should provide the flight number, passenger count, luggage, exact destination and any child-seat or vehicle requirements. Airport meeting arrangements and waiting terms are confirmed with the booking:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/

Priority airport routes:
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Town: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-ibiza-town/
- Ibiza Airport to San Antonio: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-san-antonio/
- Ibiza Airport to Santa Eulalia: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-santa-eulalia/

- Ibiza Airport to Cala Llonga: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-cala-llonga/
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Port for Formentera ferry connections: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-formentera/

For several stops or a longer schedule. Hourly, half-day, full-day and tailored itinerary bookings can be requested. The requested duration, itinerary, waiting, passenger count and vehicle requirements are reviewed before confirmation:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/

Central hotel-transport hub for airport arrivals, departure transfers, marina connections, restaurants, nightlife and tailored itineraries involving luxury hotels and resorts:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/luxury-hotel-transfers-ibiza/

### Villa Transfers Ibiza
Pre-booked transport for private villas. Exact map pin, gate or access instructions, passenger count and luggage should be supplied before confirmation:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/villa-transfers/

### Yacht and Marina Transfers Ibiza
Private transport between Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, ports and marinas. Marina, berth or practical pedestrian meeting details should be supplied where relevant:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/yacht-transfers/

### Ibiza Night Driver and Club Transfers
Pre-arranged evening and nightlife transport with outbound and return details agreed before travel:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-night-driver/

### VIP Driver Ibiza
Private itinerary transport for guests, assistants, families and groups. A lead contact, full schedule, passenger details, access notes and every requested return or intermediate stop should be supplied before confirmation:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/vip-driver-ibiza/

## Fleet
- Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle is part of the service.
- Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger count, luggage and availability.
- Child seats and specific vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

## Main Coverage
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Cap Martinet, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, Es Cubells, Cala Xarraca, Cala Conta, Cala Codolar, San Rafael / Sant Rafel, Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Sant Joan de Labritja, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, luxury hotels, resorts and private villas across Ibiza.

Formentera references on this website principally concern transport to Ibiza Port for ferry connections unless a separate service is explicitly confirmed.

## Pricing
Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, time, passenger count, luggage, stops, waiting requirements and vehicle needs. Availability and the quote are agreed before a booking is confirmed.

## Booking
A useful booking request includes:
- date
- requested pickup time
- exact pickup point
- destination or complete itinerary
- passenger count
- luggage
- requested return
- child-seat or vehicle requirements
- flight number for airport arrivals
- exact map pin and access notes for villas
- marina or practical meeting point for yacht and port collections

Booking requests are accepted through the website, WhatsApp, phone and email. A journey is confirmed only after availability, route or itinerary details and pricing have been agreed.
